reason: A portable Agent Skill primarily focused on developing, auditing, packaging, and diagnosing DeepSeek Harness plugins, with an optional profile-scoped DSH bundle adapter.

summaries.zh: 用于设计、实现、打包、审查和诊断 DeepSeek Harness 插件的可移植 Agent Skill，并提供可选的配置文件级 DSH 安装适配器。
summaries.en: A portable Agent Skill for designing, implementing, packaging, reviewing, and diagnosing DeepSeek Harness plugins, with an optional profile-scoped DSH installation adapter.

capabilities: Guides design, implementation, packaging, review, and diagnosis of DeepSeek Harness plugins
Provides documented validation and artifact-checking workflows
Optionally registers and removes the Skill through profile-scoped DSH installation
